title: No-Cloning Theorem & Linearity
question: Prove why the linearity of quantum mechanics strictly forbids the construction of a universal cloning unitary operator.

rubricCriteria.criterion: Formulation of universal cloning condition U|ψ⟩|0⟩ = |ψ⟩|ψ⟩

sampleSolution: If U clones |0> and |1>, applying U to (|0>+|1>)/sqrt(2) linearly yields (|00>+|11>)/sqrt(2), which is not the cloned state |++> = (|00>+|01>+|10>+|11>)/2.
